items.answer: AC not cooling may be caused by dirty filters, low refrigerant gas, blocked condenser, thermostat settings, or compressor issues.
Water leakage is usually caused by a blocked drain pipe, dirty filters, frozen coils, or improper installation.
Low refrigerant usually indicates a leak. Leak testing and proper gas charging are recommended.
Check thermostat settings, condenser coils, door gasket, and compressor operation.
Ice build-up may be caused by a faulty defrost system or damaged door seal.
The issue may be caused by a damaged belt, motor problem, lid switch fault, or overloaded drum.
Check the drain pump, drain hose blockage, and filter condition.
A faulty magnetron, capacitor, or door switch may prevent heating.
Check thermostat settings, heating element condition, and power supply.
Check power supply, HDMI source, backlight, and display panel condition.
Restart the router, check ISP connection, verify cables, and inspect signal strength.
The switch, wiring, MCB, or power supply may need inspection.
Inspect joints, valves, pipe cracks, and water pressure levels.
Check power supply, filters, RO membrane, and water pressure.
